scope: Round 13 source-reviewed additions for distinct console/mobile/PC targets. Methods are explicitly separated: Sonic Generations is Xbox 360 static recompilation to Android; Syphon Filter is game-specific PS1 emulation with a native Windows host; Super Mario Strikers Quest is a decompilation-based native source port to Meta Quest 3. Each project row names one target; the Quest row is separate from the existing Android phone port because it adds a Quest/OpenXR standalone headset application and mixed-reality target.

projects.title: Sonic Generations Xbox 360 Android Recompilation (ReXGlue)
projects.status: No GitHub release is listed. The maintainer reports title-screen and Green Hill testing on a Helio G99 / Mali-G57 Android device at about 2.5–4 fps; the report notes a Sonic skinning glitch and does not establish broader device or full-campaign compatibility. The README says the author does not expect to extend this ReXGlue version further. The README requires the user to provide a USA or Europe Xbox 360 game ISO.
projects.summary: Android ARM64 port of the Xbox 360 version using ReXGlue static recompilation: Xbox 360 PowerPC code is generated as C++ ahead of time, then built with Android NDK/Gradle and Android-specific Vulkan compatibility patches. This is static recompilation, not runtime emulation or an API translation layer.
projects.source_available: Public repository includes generated C++ game code and Android NDK/Gradle sources; the README requires a user-supplied Xbox 360 ISO. GitHub reports no declared project license.
projects.subtype: Xbox 360 static recompilation via ReXGlue; Android native ARM64 target

projects.title: Syphon Filter Windows Runtime (Game-Specific PlayStation Emulator)
projects.status: Public-test release 0.2.0-beta.2 was published on 2026-08-13. The maintainer README lists the complete 20-mission campaign flow and related gameplay systems, while labeling the software a public test; no independent full-campaign verification is claimed. The user supplies the supported USA v1.1 BIN/CUE image.
projects.summary: A game-specific PlayStation runtime for Windows x64. The original R3000A game program executes through emulated PS1 CPU, GTE, bus, IRQ, DMA, CD-ROM and audio systems; native Windows code handles presentation, input, launcher, storage and FMV playback. This is emulation-based, not a matching decompilation or static recompilation.
projects.strategy: Game-specific PlayStation emulation with native Windows presentation
projects.source_available: Public MIT source and public-test Windows x64 release; the repository and release exclude game files and require the supported USA v1.1 BIN/CUE image.
projects.subtype: Game-specific PS1 guest runtime/emulator; Windows x64 host

projects.title: Quest 3 Strikers: Super Mario Strikers Mixed-Reality Port
projects.platform: Nintendo GameCube → Meta Quest 3 standalone (Android ARM64 / OpenXR)
projects.status: Free alpha; v0.1.11-alpha1 APK was published on 2026-10-16. The maintainer reports testing on Quest 3, including online matches between two Quest 3 headsets; other headset models are untested. The release requires the user’s own Super Mario Strikers game image and contains no game files.
projects.summary: Quest 3-specific native ARM/OpenXR port built from the Super Mario Strikers community decompilation and based on the catalogued Android phone port. It adds passthrough mixed reality, a tabletop pitch and stadium VR modes. This is a decompilation-based source port, not static recompilation or emulation.
projects.strategy: Native source port using community decompilation code
projects.source_available: Public GPL-3.0 source and Quest APK release; README states that no game files are included and a user-owned GameCube game image is required.
projects.subtype: Decompilation-based native source port; Meta Quest 3 Android ARM64/OpenXR mixed-reality application
